verdict.rationale: Codegen supports event-driven agent activity: agents can be triggered from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail via the API, a PR-review flow reads diffs, runs scans and posts comments on failure, and PR-linked 'checks' run agents automatically. However, there is no documented first-class rule engine for defining event→action rules; most triggering relies on API/SDK wiring or fixed behaviors such as mention-based responses. Missing for 10: a native configurable event-trigger/rule builder, documentation of supported event types and conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
